status: implemented; review 12 finding fixed; acceptance sets A/B/C pass on final source; PostgreSQL compiled/vetted only; 6d3 JSON remains

api.constants: 8 DateUnit, 13 TimestampUnit and PostgresStandardTime; shared values/validation owned by querycore
api.phase: RowValue inputs retain S; Value-suffixed functions accept Selected only; text selected comparisons return HavingPredicate. Nullable functions retain one nullable layer except ConcatWS, which skips NULL and returns present string.
api.typing: Calendar: Date/LocalDateTime; clock: Time/LocalDateTime; instant: time.Time/DateTime. Fractional seconds/Julian day/epoch seconds return decimal.Decimal; FromUnixMillis requires integers. Date+Interval returns LocalDateTime; interval components remain distinct; geographic metres float64.
api.ownership: Uses sealed RowValue and concrete Scope; no new capabilities, no capabilities passed into application interfaces, no new Query/Table/column/aggregate methods. Both selected-text comparison wrappers structurally retain owner and selected phase, matching existing selected comparison shells.
api.compiler: Reuses ormcore.Operation and querycore.OperationNode. Shared truncation/timezone/policy/coordinate/substring validation extracted for both old and new construction; old API tests unchanged.

stage_6d.next: 6d3 JSON paths and Kind/Length; accessor design pending lead decision
